roles.title: Lead Product Manager, Banners & Content Cards

bullets: Define and own the roadmap for Content Cards and Banners, pulling from customers, sales, support, usage data, and competitive signal to figure out what matters most next
Partner with engineers and designers to execute that roadmap in a lean, entrepreneurial start-up environment
Own the commercial outcomes for your area (adoption, consumption, expansion) and understand the unit economics well enough to make good investment tradeoffs
Establish and manage internal and external customer expectations, including with enterprise accounts and in renewal and expansion conversations
Deeply understand our technology, business, customers, and market
